From Green, Green Grass of Home · Price: only inside a zone you marked beforehand.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 minute: mark a 20-ft zone. Inside it, you and your stand move double your Speed.
  • 5: Enemies inside the zone treat it as difficult terrain.
  • 9: Surge: shrink a creature's distance to you: a creature inside the zone is pulled adjacent to your stand (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 13: Zone becomes 40 ft.
  • 17: Enemies inside the zone treat it as greater difficult terrain.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
